intent: Hold an alert dialog's leading icon or small illustration on a filled square plate above its title.
typical_uses: A warning glyph above the question of a destructive confirmation

dont_use_when.situation: A person's or entity's picture with a fallback

invariants.text: AlertDialogMedia is a fixed 4rem square with rounded corners, filled with var(--muted), that centers its content; it does not size the content itself.

good.title: A warning glyph at the head of a confirmation

bad.title: The media placed straight in the popup
bad.why: As a direct child of the popup the plate takes the popup's region inset, a var(--space-6) padding on each side inside its fixed 4rem width, which leaves 1rem for the glyph; inside AlertDialogHeader it keeps its full plate and is aligned with the title - centered, or at the start from a 640px-wide viewport at the default size.
